title: Realized Gains
description: Realized gains and losses on sold holdings, consolidated across all your accounts and brokers — grouped by year and holding period (short vs long term). NOTE: this is derived from your ledger and is NOT a tax document. It does not apply wash-sale rules or your broker's lot-selection method, so it can differ from your 1099-B. For tax purposes, use your broker's 1099-B / official statements.

widgets.title: Realized Gain (all-time)
widgets.helpText: Total realized gain/loss across all sold holdings and accounts. Ledger-derived, not for tax filing.

steps.query: SELECT price_currency AS currency, ROUND(SUM(ABS(CAST(amount AS REAL)) * (CAST(price_amount AS REAL) - CAST(cost_amount AS REAL))), 2) AS amount FROM postings p JOIN commodities c ON c.code = p.currency WHERE c.is_currency = 0 AND p.cost_amount IS NOT NULL AND p.price_amount IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.amount AS REAL) < 0 GROUP BY price_currency HAVING amount != 0 ORDER BY price_currency

widgets.title: Realized Gain (latest year)
widgets.helpText: Realized gain/loss booked in the most recent year that has sales. Ledger-derived, not for tax filing.

steps.query: SELECT price_currency AS currency, ROUND(SUM(ABS(CAST(amount AS REAL)) * (CAST(price_amount AS REAL) - CAST(cost_amount AS REAL))), 2) AS amount FROM postings p JOIN commodities c ON c.code = p.currency WHERE c.is_currency = 0 AND p.cost_amount IS NOT NULL AND p.price_amount IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.amount AS REAL) < 0 AND p.year = (SELECT MAX(year) FROM postings p2 JOIN commodities c2 ON c2.code = p2.currency WHERE c2.is_currency = 0 AND p2.cost_amount IS NOT NULL AND p2.price_amount IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p2.amount AS REAL) < 0) GROUP BY price_currency HAVING amount != 0 ORDER BY price_currency

widgets.title: Realized Gain by Year (short vs long term)
widgets.helpText: Realized gain per year, split by holding period. Held over one year = long term. Ledger-derived, not a tax document.

steps.query: SELECT CAST(year AS TEXT) AS year, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN julianday(transaction_date) - julianday(cost_date) > 365 THEN ABS(CAST(amount AS REAL)) * (CAST(price_amount AS REAL) - CAST(cost_amount AS REAL)) ELSE 0 END), 2) AS long_term, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN julianday(transaction_date) - julianday(cost_date) <= 365 THEN ABS(CAST(amount AS REAL)) * (CAST(price_amount AS REAL) - CAST(cost_amount AS REAL)) ELSE 0 END), 2) AS short_term FROM postings p JOIN commodities c ON c.code = p.currency WHERE c.is_currency = 0 AND p.cost_amount IS NOT NULL AND p.price_amount IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.amount AS REAL) < 0 AND p.price_currency = :currency GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

visualization.emptyText: No sales recorded in this currency. (This view is ledger-derived, not a tax document.)

widgets.title: Sales
widgets.helpText: Every sale: sale date, the lot's acquisition date, holding period, cost basis, proceeds, and realized gain. Consolidated across accounts. Ledger-derived — for tax, use your broker's 1099-B.

steps.query: SELECT transaction_date AS sale_date, currency AS holding, ROUND(ABS(CAST(amount AS REAL)), 4) AS units, cost_date AS acquired, CAST(julianday(transaction_date) - julianday(cost_date) AS INTEGER) AS holding_days, CASE WHEN julianday(transaction_date) - julianday(cost_date) > 365 THEN 'Long' ELSE 'Short' END AS term, ROUND(ABS(CAST(amount AS REAL)) * CAST(cost_amount AS REAL), 2) AS cost_basis, ROUND(ABS(CAST(amount AS REAL)) * CAST(price_amount AS REAL), 2) AS proceeds, ROUND(ABS(CAST(amount AS REAL)) * (CAST(price_amount AS REAL) - CAST(cost_amount AS REAL)), 2) AS gain FROM postings p JOIN commodities c ON c.code = p.currency WHERE c.is_currency = 0 AND p.cost_amount IS NOT NULL AND p.price_amount IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.amount AS REAL) < 0 AND p.price_currency = :currency ORDER BY transaction_date DESC

visualization.emptyText: No sales recorded in this currency. (Ledger-derived; not a tax document.)
